If you have a specific API endpoint or method for logging out, let me know and I can help you construct the request.

Alternatively, if you actually meant to log in again (perhaps to refresh your session), you can provide your credentials and I can call the `user_authentication_login` function for you. Just let me know what you’d like to do next!
